records.title: Garciaguirre et al. v. Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. et al.
records.summary: Putative class action alleging coordinated restrictions on conventional DRAM supply and pricing. The court denied the defendants’ motion to dismiss on November 14, 2026. This is an existing baseline case, not a newly filed matter.
records.scope: Consumers and small businesses; federal antitrust and state-law claims.

records.title: Kessler Topaz Meltzer & Check
records.summary: Firm announcement investigating potential federal securities-law violations on behalf of investors, citing reports of the DRAM dismissal ruling. The announcement does not establish that a securities complaint has been filed.
records.scope: Investors who acquired SK hynix securities and experienced significant losses; class period not confirmed.

records.title: Rosen Law Firm
records.summary: Firm announcement investigating potential securities claims and inviting investors to join a prospective class action. The firm states it is preparing an action; a filed securities complaint has not been independently verified here.
records.scope: Shareholders; alleged misleading business information. Class period not confirmed.

records.title: Levi & Korsinsky
records.summary: Public investigation page concerning disclosures about the DRAM price-fixing litigation and related exposure. Publication date is not confirmed. This is a solicitation, not confirmation of a filed securities action.
records.scope: SK hynix investors; class period not confirmed.
